core_identity.short_form: Black seeks power by facing the world as it is and using every available resource.
core_identity.summary: Black is the mono-color expression of agency under harsh conditions: it looks at fear, death, ambition, cost, and opportunity without flinching.
core_identity.philosophy: Black asks who benefits when you pretend the world is fair. It believes survival and thriving require self-advocacy, resource conversion, and freedom from inherited taboos.
core_identity.central_tension: Black can be brutally honest about power, but the tools that free it can also consume it.

structure.non_faction_boundary: Black is an official color philosophy and mechanical color-pie identity, not a single plane, faction, personality type, or commander recommendation list.

great_tension.gift: Black refuses comforting lies about power and cost.
great_tension.shadow: Black can turn every bond into leverage and every risk into a debt coming due.
great_tension.boundary: This is Vox Mana synthesis from official color philosophy, not official psychometrics.

mechanics.summary: Black commonly plays by converting life, creatures, cards, death, and risk into advantage.

site_surface.short_summary: Black faces power, cost, death, and ambition directly, then asks what can be made from them.
site_surface.one_sentence_identity: Black is the hand reaching into the dark because the prize is still there.
site_surface.tagline: Pay the cost. Take the power.

data_quality.notes: Three native mono-black commander rows are retained only after current Scryfall verification on 2026-06-13. Deck links remain intentionally empty; these rows do not prove color philosophy or Vox Mana placement axes.

research_limitations: Do not moralize Black as objective evil.
Do not treat Vox Mana placement axes as official Wizards scores.
Do not promote candidate commanders without current card/legal verification.
Do not use generated runtime files as claim evidence.

profile.overview: Black is the color of power, opportunity, self-interest, death, and resource conversion.
profile.philosophy: Black believes no one can advocate for you better than you, and that refusing available tools only leaves power in someone else's hands.
profile.core_tension: Black's clarity about cost can become self-consuming risk or total instrumentalization.
profile.mechanics_and_play_pattern: Black commonly expresses itself through removal, discard, sacrifice, graveyard recursion, life payments, drain, and reanimation.
